subject: E-Commerce
title: The Verticalization of Marketplaces
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Verticalization of Marketplaces.

hook.text: Farfetch for luxury, Reverb for guitars, Vinted for clothes. Niche marketplaces are stealing categories from Amazon.

buildup.text: General marketplaces can't offer the expertise that niche categories demand.

discovery.text: The Verticalization of Marketplaces reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Amazon fights back by adding specialty features. It launched luxury authentication and expanded its fashion try-on.

climax.text: Vertical marketplaces win on expertise while Amazon wins on convenience. The battle is specialization vs scale.

punchline.text: Farfetch, Reverb, Vinted. When expertise matters, niche wins.

quiz.question: Why do niche marketplaces succeed against Amazon in specific categories?
options: They build category-specific expertise and tools that general platforms can't match
